plain_description.what: Re-reads the fair back-off comparison with the borrowing strength fixed instead of tuned, and with the items the tree files into another benchmark's cell removed. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: TREE-BACKOFF's gain depended on the tuned strength and partly on cross-benchmark filings; this checks whether the fair comparison's verdict depends on either.
plain_description.information: Shows whether the fair back-off verdict depends on the tuned blending strength or on cross-benchmark filings. Result: done, robust: with a fixed strength and without those filings the verdict (k-means slightly better, no difference in gain) is unchanged. Each difference is still below what the test could reliably call.
